title: Create models for stock and transaction entities (Stock, StockMovement, Transaction, TransactionItem, TransactionPayment)
acceptance_criteria: Stock model with unique composite key (outlet_id, product_variant_id)
StockMovement model with type enum and reference_type/reference_id polymorphic fields
Transaction model with client_uuid unique idempotency key and status enum
TransactionItem model with product_name_snapshot and price_snapshot fields
TransactionPayment model with payment_method relation and change_amount
All models use Goravel orm conventions and are registered for migration/query
completion_summary: Generated 5 models via make:model --table; added relations (Outlet/Variant/CreatedBy on stock, Transaction Cashier/Customer/Items/Payments, Item/Payment FKs); ORM queries verified
